messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — nightly evals showed a sudden quality spike after the stochastic RNG accumulator change merged last night. 3 prompt sets with timing-sensitive completions are affected. attaching examples below. :eyes:
Samir Gupta: ugh. which PR/commit? can you paste the commit hash?
Maya Chen: commit 8f4b2a9 — small refactor in rng_accumulator.c to collapse partial state updates. suspect boundary rounding.
Leo Park: can you paste an example of the mismatch (gold vs model)?
Maya Chen: sure — from prompt set ‘summaries-quick’ (truncated):
```
GOLD: "In short, the release reduced latency by 30% and preserved accuracy."
NIGHTLY: "In short, the release reduced latency 30% and accuracy preserved."  <-- word order shift, tokenization different leading to eval failure
```
Irene V: that looks like a tokenization/spacing drift, but we saw several cases with different punctuation too. could be RNG seeding changes affecting top-k picks.
Samir Gupta: i ran the same model binary locally with and without the patch. got nondet diffs in the sampling path even with same seed. suspect we accidentally changed how we advance the RNG between attention rounds.
Leo Park: do we log RNG state? we should reproduce minimal repro (single shot, fixed seed).
Maya Chen: repro attached in thread as a gist. core snippet I used:
```
set_seed(42);
for (int layer=0; layer<n_layers; ++layer) {
  compute_attention(...);
  rng_accumulator_step(state, layer);
}
sample_token(state);
```
Samir Gupta: here's an output diff when I toggled the accumulator update ordering: the baseline keeps one extra advance before sampling, new code advances after layer loop — that will shift entire stream.
Irene V: can we roll back the accumulator reorder for nightly until we fix? Risk: we lose perf gains. Maybe toggle behind a feature flag keyed for nightly so we can compare metrics side-by-side.
Maya Chen: filed revert PR for safety (DONT_MERGE until we validate). Also opening feature-flag PR to gate the reordering and add explicit RNG-check unit tests.
ci-bot: nightly-eval: summary=regression; severity=high; affected=3 prompt sets; alert=oncall@redwood.ai
ops-bot: created incident ticket INF-2026 for investigation and mitigation.
Samir Gupta: next steps: 1) add rng-state logging with deterministic seed for failing prompts; 2) add unit test that asserts token stream equality for fixed-seed micro runs; 3) instrument to compare pre/post RNG-stream offset. I can take 1 and 3.
Maya Chen: thanks — I'll own the feature-flag revert and tests. tagging @Irene for model eval triage once we have deterministic repros.
Irene V: will run a sweep of prompt sets with the deterministic harness and post summary in #eng-ml later today.
Maya Chen: tl;dr — suspected change in RNG advancement ordering in rng_accumulator caused sampling shifts. blocking revert + deterministic tests being added. will update when CI has repros and a candidate fix. :thumbsup:
